privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: A concise in-app summary. The public policy URL will be finalized before App Store submission.
items: We store your email address, hashed password, tasks, tags, due dates, reminders, sync metadata, and productivity stats so TaskFlow can work across devices.
Passwords are stored as hashes. We do not store your plain text password.
Your tasks are private to your account and are not shared with other users.
You can delete your account from this app. Deleting an account removes synced tasks, stats, and sessions.
Reminder times schedule local system notifications when notification permission is enabled.
